cyclingBackPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production POSED BACK REFERENCE for an original Chinese university campus cycling game. Image1 is the identity/proportion/front-costume reference; image2 is the same person's standing BACK, the anatomical and garment reference that must be preserved. Image3 is the exact published university seal, supporting garment print reference. Create ONE detailed clean rear-view image of this SAME fictional 21-year-old East Asian male while naturally riding a dark green everyday city bicycle with black tires, rear luggage rack, mudguards, a front basket, realistic handlebar/saddle/pedal spacing. Core subject: a convincing HUMAN CYCLING UPPER BACK. The navy regular-fit cotton crewneck sweatshirt has clearly readable shoulder corners, deltoid caps and normal set-in shoulder seams; clavicles and shoulder blades support a broad upper-back plane, neck emerges naturally between shoulders. Back maintains believable rectangular ribcage volume, not a triangular tent/cone from neck to elbows, not sloping missing shoulders. Natural light forward protraction of scapulae, shoulders stay broad and at nearly the same height; short gentle trapezius slopes. Torso leans forward about 25 degrees from vertical from the hips toward the bars, elbows slightly bent and directed outward naturally, wrists/palms align with the real handlebar grips, pelvis seated squarely on saddle, no stretched arms or hunched turtle neck. Head upright to look forward, black hair same as reference, no face turned toward camera. Same navy sweatshirt/charcoal tapered trousers/ivory lace-up athletic sneakers, no leather shoes. Show a restrained ivory-white single-color version of the provided round ZJU seal centered on the upper-back cloth, about 22cm wide with a margin from the sleeve seams and neck; the emblem stays round in cloth coordinates and follows natural mild folds, never a giant triangular badge. Do not add other lettering or logos. CAMERA: almost exact rear elevation with only 10 degrees elevation so both shoulder widths are obvious, long-lens near-orthographic projection, no wide-angle warping. Frame from above head to below saddle/upper thighs with hands and handlebars included; upper back large and legible, the bicycle may extend outside this purposeful upper-body crop. Neutral light-gray studio background, softly diffused neutral lighting with readable cotton folds over shoulder blades and gentle highlights, polished stylized 3D realism matching the provided person. One rider, one pose, no layout panels, no captions, text labels, anatomy arrows, skeleton overlay, scenery, pedestal, duplicate limbs or watermark. This is a pose reference for rigging, not a new character or a background scene.
